# PLOS Journals

> PLOS is a collection of peer-reviewed, open-access scientific journals covering biology, health, medicine, climate, and environmental research.

PLOS (Public Library of Science) operates 16 specialized journals spanning disciplines from computational biology and genetics to global health, climate science, and digital health. All content is published under Creative Commons licensing with open-access principles, making research freely available to the scientific community and public.

## Key Topics

- open-access publishing
- peer-reviewed journals
- global health
- infectious disease
- computational biology
- genetics and evolution
- climate research
- neuroscience
- aging research
- digital health and AI
- tropical diseases
- ecosystem conservation
- public health equity
- Creative Commons licensing
- research articles

## Flagship Multidisciplinary Journals

- [PLOS One](https://journals.plos.org/plosone): PLOS One multidisciplinary open-access journal for peer-reviewed research
- [PLOS Biology](https://journals.plos.org/plosbiology): PLOS Biology peer-reviewed journal featuring neuroscience and microbiology

## Health and Medical Research

- [PLOS Medicine](https://journals.plos.org/plosmedicine): PLOS Medicine open-access journal for global health and infectious disease
- [PLOS Global Public Health](https://journals.plos.org/globalpublichealth): PLOS Global Public Health journal for health equity and public health research
- [PLOS Digital Health](https://journals.plos.org/digitalhealth): PLOS Digital Health journal covering AI healthcare and health informatics
- [PLOS Aging and Health](https://journals.plos.org/agingandhealth): PLOS Aging and Health journal homepage with editors and research focus
- [PLOS Mental Health](https://journals.plos.org/mentalhealth): PLOS Mental Health peer-reviewed journal for mental health epidemiology research

## Genetics, Evolution, and Computational Biology

- [PLOS Genetics](https://journals.plos.org/plosgenetics): PLOS Genetics open-access journal for population genetics and evolutionary biology
- [PLOS Computational Biology](https://journals.plos.org/ploscompbiol): PLOS Computational Biology peer-reviewed journal for bioinformatics research

## Infectious Disease and Pathology

- [PLOS Pathogens](https://journals.plos.org/plospathogens): PLOS Pathogens peer-reviewed journal for infectious disease and immunology
- [PLOS Neglected Tropical Diseases](https://journals.plos.org/plosntds): PLOS Neglected Tropical Diseases journal for parasitic and tropical disease research

## Environmental and Climate Science

- [PLOS Climate](https://journals.plos.org/climate): PLOS Climate open-access journal for climate research and mitigation
- [PLOS Ecosystems](https://journals.plos.org/ecosystems): PLOS Ecosystems journal for biodiversity conservation and ecosystem research
- [PLOS Water](https://journals.plos.org/water): PLOS Water journal for water research, governance, and health topics
- [PLOS Sustainability and Transformation](https://journals.plos.org/sustainabilitytransformation): PLOS Sustainability and Transformation journal for environmental and climate policy

## Specialized Research Areas

- [PLOS Complex Systems](https://journals.plos.org/complexsystems): PLOS Complex Systems journal for network analysis and computational modeling
